plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sat with {PET_definite} for a long time and wouldn't talk about it.
{PAWN_nameDef} took {PET_nameDef}'s collar off and has kept it in {PAWN_possessive} pocket since.
[quiet] {PET_nameDef} lay down and didn't get up again. {PAWN_nameDef} was the one who found it.
[quiet] {PAWN_nameDef} stayed beside {PET_nameDef} at the end, and says it wasn't afraid.
[oldage] {PET_nameDef} had been slowing down for a long time. {PAWN_nameDef} says it went the way an old animal should.
[oldage] {PET_nameDef} was old, and {PAWN_nameDef} had known for a while that it wouldn't last the year.
[hero] {PET_nameDef} was killed in the fighting, and {PAWN_nameDef} wants it buried where everyone will see the grave.
[hero,small] {PET_nameDef} was small, and it went for them anyway. {PAWN_nameDef} says that is how it should be remembered.
[hero,big] {PET_nameDef} went at the enemy head on, {PAWN_nameDef} says, and kept going until it fell.
[defended] When {PAWN_nameDef} was hurt, {PET_definite} stood over {PAWN_objective} and snarled at anyone who came near.
[defended] {PET_nameDef} would not leave {PAWN_nameDef}'s side while {PAWN_pronoun} was hurt, and went for anyone who came near.
[defended,midsize] {PET_nameDef} went for whatever had hurt {PAWN_nameDef} and wouldn't let go.
[fought] {PET_nameDef} followed {PAWN_nameDef} into the fight without being called, and kept close the whole time.
[fought,midsize] {PET_nameDef} stayed close to {PAWN_nameDef} through the whole fight and went for any enemy that came within reach.
[fought,big] {PET_nameDef} charged into the fight beside {PAWN_nameDef}, and the enemy had to deal with both of them.
